nodes.label: Golden-Path Demo
nodes.rationale: The single end-to-end workflow judges will see; drives MVP scope and smoke tests.

nodes.label: Mission: Best Demonstrable Hackathon Solution
nodes.rationale: Optimize for a compelling, reliable end-to-end demo rather than enterprise ceremony; problem statement and stack are not yet known.

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.rationale: Use supplied OpenAI credits; keep model IDs, endpoints and pricing configurable.

nodes.label: Phase 0: Before the Problem Statement
nodes.rationale: Be ready to pivot without locking into the wrong stack; no speculative agents, frameworks or infra.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Problem Statement to Solution Plan
nodes.norm_label: phase 1: problem statement to solution plan

nodes.label: Phase 3: AWS Deployment and CI/CD
nodes.rationale: Obtain a real reachable AWS deployment before major polishing; mark BLOCKED rather than DONE when credentials are missing.

nodes.label: Phase 4: Demo Quality and Selective Hardening
nodes.norm_label: phase 4: demo quality and selective hardening

nodes.label: Terraform
nodes.rationale: Create only after hosting architecture is chosen; an empty scaffold is not progress.

nodes.label: CI Repository Hygiene Checks
nodes.rationale: Generic checks that actually run before a stack exists: no .env/state/private keys, no conflict markers, no files over 5 MB.

nodes.label: Change-Scope Rules
nodes.rationale: Update only artifacts affected by a feature; no placeholder tests, fake green checks, or unvalidated Terraform.

nodes.label: Cost Awareness
nodes.rationale: Lowest sensible footprint; OpenAI credits do not pay AWS bills; watch NAT, ALB, DB, always-on compute.

nodes.label: Deterministic Stubs and Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Lets demos recover from external API outages.

nodes.label: Priority Order
nodes.rationale: Solve the problem first, then thin local path, early AWS deploy, then quality, then selective hardening; on conflict choose the smallest reversible path to a live demo.

nodes.label: Prototype Fast, Deploy Early, Harden Selectively
nodes.norm_label: prototype fast, deploy early, harden selectively
nodes.rationale: Avoid front-loading Terraform, docs, security tooling or tests before the main workflow works.

nodes.label: Single Agent Before Multi-Agent
nodes.rationale: Use tool-calling agents only when autonomy/multi-step decisions improve the solution.

nodes.label: Small Vertical Slices
nodes.rationale: One complete user journey beats five unfinished features.
